title: Watch agents accepted feedback fixes

params.text: an agent run is in progress and stays with the parent

params.when: an agent hands work to a child agent as an explicit handoff

state.text: the parent run accepts the handoff and assigns the next work to that child

params.text: the child appears under its parent, queued until assignment

params.title: A rejected handoff ends cleanly
params.when: the child agent refuses the handed work

then.text: the parent run ends that child path cleanly

params.title: A child already parented stays linked
params.when: an agent hands work to a child already parented

then.text: the parent run keeps the existing parent-child link

params.title: A run ending aborts its dangling child
params.when: the parent run ends while handing work to a child

then.text: the dangling child is aborted with the run

params.title: A service outside the operator-granted scopes is refused
params.when: an agent uses a service outside the operator-granted scopes

params.title: Agent surfaces a refused service to extend the grant
params.when: the agent surfaces the refusal to the operator

then.text: the operator extends the operator-granted scopes

params.text: the agent requests an env file in its declared workspace

params.title: Env files beyond served scopes are refused
params.when: an agent reads an env file beyond its served powers

params.text: the read is refused, reason names file and blocking gate

state.text: the reason says widen scope or ask operator

params.title: Env files within served scopes are served
params.when: an agent reads an env file within its served powers

then.text: the read is served with the file path
